definitions: To attempt a task that is too big or difficult to handle.
To take on more responsibility than one can manage.
examples: She bit off more than she could chew with three jobs and night classes.
Don't bite off more than you can chew when planning the event.
He realized he had bitten off more than he could chew with the renovation.
lemma: bite off more than one can chew
